title: Dumaahi magaalal tan farmo
intro: Qaane le dumaahi magaalaay, tet ummatta angoddat raddem kee ellecabo maabitina hangi kah acee waytannah abte. asaaku, maaqatta yalli ruube marih doori farmo giddile ummattah tatrussuh. Cinni aydaadu, dubuk yan imaan xongoloo kee ellecabo finqah tan amrit alfimte. iyyaay too rortal yabtam?
clues: Nee rubbem yalli ummattay cakkik tiddire magaala fan .
Nammay nek naharak yemeete, tokkeek sidoc haytu ni farmo maqarrosnuh yengele
Magaalah mari ken innah tan sahdayti baxak tu hinnino iyyaanam nee cineh.
Inki rooci magaalak allal yan exxak kudak ummattah nee kattaataanam warisuh
Nanu ken luk xagana hayneh, takkay immay oson sinni sorkocô baxa maqarroosak nee fanah yuduureenih
qaraanak inki finqitte weeqak, ni magaala inkih tibba inte

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
